description: This is a test class for the ProviderService component in the OpenMRS API project. It contains unit tests for various functionalities related to Provider, ProviderAttributeType, ProviderRole, and associated data management methods, including CRUD operations, searches, retire/unretire, and role management.

classes.name: ProviderServiceTest
classes.description: Test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to verify the functionality of ProviderService methods in the openmrs-core project.
